products.description_en: The comprehensive organizational traffic control system designed and produced by the Beta Smart Makers Company is an integrated solution consisting of physical barriers, software, hardware and smart identifiers to control and manage the traffic of people to organizations on foot or by car. With the support of biometric technologies, including facial and fingerprint recognition, cards, this system provides the possibility of centralized and intelligent management of the traffic of employees and clients. This QR Code, fingerprint reader and RFID system, with high expandability and scalability, flexibility in implementation and the ability to integrate with other organizational systems, creates a stable and safe platform for improving security and increasing the productivity of organizations. Also with the ability to support traffic. 1000 people per hour and the possibility of online and offline operation, it meets the needs of large and high-traffic organizations, and also having an integrated HSE system, providing detailed reports and documentation for security units, human resources, and managing the traffic of employees and clients, is one of the other capabilities of this comprehensive solution.
